The SAME mysterious sun-witch girl from reference: wide ivory and dusty pink pointed sun-brooch hat, short cream platinum hair wisps, face under opaque deep hat shadow so ONLY small pale chin is visible (no eyes/nose/mouth), flowing fully clothed layered ivory/rose cloak with simple antique-gold sun brooch/trim, very pale skin, golden sun-tipped slim staff. Graceful modest silhouette; no exposed cleavage. In medium or wide shots preserve connected sleeves/hands. If feet shown they are bare. Never replace with an exposed-face anime girl. Witch's hat-shadow face only partly visible behind left edge, small. The shards are a LIMITED frontal barrier, not an enclosing impenetrable bubble. Dark plum stone room, bold graphic reflected highlights, sparse glass sparkle. Mirrors and reflection action are the focal subject.

cards.name: 弓背
cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game card illustration only, landscape 25:19 (roughly 4:3), full-bleed, without card frame or UI.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY ART STYLE reference; copy its rough hand-painted gouache, expressive angular interlocking brush shapes, selective dark plum contour, matte painted surface, atmospheric slate-purple masonry and strong warm/cool light contrast. Do not copy the girl or any objects from image 1. Image 2 is the CAT IDENTITY reference only: preserve this same small cream-and-silver-gray long-haired kitten, clever amber eyes, natural quadrupedal anatomy, long relaxed torso, small round paws, fluffy curved tail, triangular ears and silver-gray crown/back markings. Style: Slay the Spire 2-inspired expressive gouache fantasy card art, tactile visible brushwork, clear bold silhouette, quiet dark bluish-plum stone ruins, warm ivory highlights and restrained golden-white/soft-pink magic. Compact readable single action at 250x190. Keep the kitten unmistakably the same identity across the set. No text, letters, numerals, watermarks, borders, UI, human girl, second cat, garments, collars or accessories. No photorealism, no plastic 3D, no smooth anime cel shading, no dense repetitive particle noise.

It arches its back defensively with fur fluffed and alert amber eyes looking toward an offscreen threat.
